ngaap.guidance: 2021 guidance updated 30-Apr-2021: Revenue $18.5 billion - $18.9 billion, excluding effect of divestitures, up organically 3.0% - 5.0% (unchanged from previous guidance). Adjusted EBIT margin of 18.0% - 18.5% (unchanged). Non-GAAP EPS of $12.70 - $13.00 (previous guidance of $12.60 - $13.00). Adjusted free cash flow of $2.8 billion - $2.9 billion (unchanged). ~$2.3 billion in share repurchases, excluding use of divestiture proceeds (unchanged). No GAAP net income margin, GAAP EPS or operating cash flow guidance is given in this release (only the non-GAAP metrics above).
ngaap.notes: Non-GAAP EPS = income from continuing operations per diluted share attributable to common shareholders, excluding L3Harris Merger integration costs, amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (all acquired intangibles), business divestiture-related gains/losses and other divestiture-related expenses, impairment of goodwill and other assets / investment and asset impairment charges, restructuring and other items, net of the noncontrolling-interest portion and of income taxes. Adjusted EBIT = net income + discontinued operations + net interest expense + income taxes + the same pre-tax items (it INCLUDES non-operating income / non-service FAS pension income). Adjusted free cash flow = operating cash flow - net additions of PP&E + cash used for L3Harris Merger integration costs. The prior-year Q1-20 bridge is re-presented: 'Impairment of goodwill and other assets related to divestitures and the impacts of COVID' 324 (was 330) and 'Restructuring charges and other items' 6 (new line); total unchanged. Dollar tax effect / NCI portion not published. The release also gives U.S. and international government revenue (excl. commercial aviation, Public Safety and other commercial): 4,174 vs 3,982 (+4.8%). From this release the guidance list contains non-GAAP metrics only.
